ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE ACT ON THE PROMOTION OF AND SUPPORT FOR ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education and its Enforcement Decree and matters necessary for their enforcement.

Article 2 (Designation of excellent schools in environmental education)
(1) The criteria for designation of excellent schools in environmental education under Article 11(1) of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") (hereinafter referred to as "excellent schools in environmental education") shall be as follows:
1. Whether a regular environmental education curriculum has been organized;
2. Creativity and excellence of environmental education programs;
3. Appropriateness of the operation of environmental education programs.
(2) The head of a school intending to obtain designation as an excellent school in environmental education under Article 11(2) of the Act shall submit an application for designation of an excellent school in environmental education in attached Form 1 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Materials capable of proving that the relevant environmental education program meets the criteria in each subparagraph of paragraph (1);
2. An operating plan for the excellent school in environmental education.
(3) Upon receiving an application for designation under paragraph (2), the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall examine the application and determine whether to designate the school as an excellent school in environmental education. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) Where an excellent school in environmental education is designated under paragraph (3), the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall issue a certificate of designation in attached Form 2 to the head of the school and publicly announce the designation on the website of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(5) The period of validity of designation of an excellent school in environmental education under Article 11(5) of the Act shall be three years.

Article 3 (Designation and revocation of designation of social environmental education institutions)
(1) A person intending to obtain designation as a social environmental education institution under Article 15(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "social environmental education institution") shall submit an application for designation in attached Form 3, accompanied by the following documents, to the Special Metropolitan City Mayor, a Metropolitan City Mayor, a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, a Do Governor, or a Special Self-Governing Province Governor (hereinafter referred to as a "Mayor/Do Governor"):
1. The following documents confirming compliance with the designation requirements under Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"):
(a) Articles of incorporation or business operating regulations that establish the purpose of establishment;
(b) Documents confirming that at least one environmental educator, etc. is regularly employed.
2. A social environmental education operating plan for the relevant corporation or organization.
(2) Where a Mayor/Do Governor receiving an application under paragraph (1) designates a social environmental education institution under Article 15(1) of the Act, the Mayor/Do Governor shall issue a certificate of designation in attached Form 4 and publicly announce the designation on the website of the relevant Special Metropolitan City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Do, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as a "City/Do").
(3) A Mayor/Do Governor intending to revoke the designation of a social environmental education institution under Article 15(3) of the Act shall hold a hearing.
(4) Where a Mayor/Do Governor revokes the designation of a social environmental education institution under Article 15(3) of the Act, the Mayor/Do Governor shall notify the institution of that fact without delay and publicly announce it on the website of the relevant City/Do.
(5) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (4), matters necessary for designation and revocation of designation of social environmental education institutions shall be prescribed by ordinance.

Article 4 (Issuance and reissuance of environmental educator certificates)
(1) A person intending to obtain an environmental educator certificate under Article 16(1) of the Act shall submit an application for issuance of an environmental educator certificate in attached Form 5, accompanied by the following documents, to the head of the National Environmental Education Center under Article 24 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "National Environmental Education Center"):
1. Documents proving compliance with the qualification requirements under Article 15(1) and Appendix 1 of the Decree;
2. A basic certificate under the Act on Registration of Family Relations.
(2) Upon receiving the submission under paragraph (1), the head of the National Environmental Education Center shall issue an environmental educator certificate in attached Form 6 to a person qualified as an environmental educator and enter that fact in the register of issuance of environmental educator certificates in attached Form 7.
(3) A person issued a certificate under paragraph (2) who intends to have it reissued because it has been lost, its entries have changed, or it has become worn and unusable shall submit an application for reissuance of an environmental educator certificate in attached Form 5 to the head of the National Environmental Education Center, accompanied by the document under paragraph (1)2 and the certificate (except where it has been lost).

Article 5 (Criteria for revocation and suspension of environmental educator qualifications) The criteria for revocation and suspension of environmental educator qualifications under Article 17(1) of the Act shall be as prescribed in Appendix 1.

Article 6 (Persons subject to continuing training for environmental educators, training periods, etc.)
(1) "Institutions prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment" in Article 18(1) of the Act means the following institutions: <Amended on February 28, 2023; October 1, 2025>
1. Schools and corporations under each item of subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act;
1-2. Child care centers under the Child Care Act;
2. Social environmental education institutions under Article 15(1) of the Act;
3. Environmental educator training institutions under Article 19 of the Act;
4. The National Environmental Education Center;
5. Metropolitan environmental education centers under Article 25(1) of the Act and basic environmental education centers under paragraph (2) of that Article.
(2) Persons subject to continuing training under Article 18(1) of the Act, the training periods, and other matters shall be as prescribed in Appendix 2.

Article 7 (Applications for designation of environmental educator training institutions)
(1) A person intending to obtain designation as an environmental educator training institution under Article 19 of the Act and Article 16(2) of the Decree (hereinafter referred to as an "environmental educator training institution") shall submit an application for designation in attached Form 8, accompanied by the documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 16(2) of the Decree, to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries (limited to the marine environmental field; hereinafter the same shall apply). <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) "Certificate of designation prescribed by Joint Decree of the Ministries" in Article 16(4) of the Decree means the certificate of designation of an environmental educator training institution in attached Form 9.

Article 8 (Revocation of designation of environmental educator training institutions) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries revokes the designation of an environmental educator training institution under Article 20(1) of the Act, the Minister shall notify the institution in writing, specifying the reasons, and publicly announce the revocation on the website of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 9 (Designation of excellent environmental education programs)
(1) The requirements for designation of an excellent environmental education program under Article 21(2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "excellent environmental education program") shall be as follows:
1. The structure and content of the environmental education program shall be excellent;
2. Qualified teaching personnel shall provide the education;
3. Measures to ensure the safety of persons receiving the education and evaluation plans shall be established.
(2) A person intending to obtain designation of an excellent environmental education program under Article 21(2) of the Act shall submit an application for designation in attached Form 10 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, accompanied by documents proving compliance with the requirements in each subparagraph of paragraph (1). Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries receives an application for designation, that Minister shall send the application in writing to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment designates an excellent environmental education program under Article 21(3) of the Act, the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation in attached Form 11 to the applicant and publicly announce the designation on the website of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) A person who has obtained designation of an excellent environmental education program under Article 21(3) of the Act may use the designation mark in accordance with Appendix 3.
(5) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (4), matters necessary for designation of excellent environmental education programs shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 10 (Revocation of designation of excellent environmental education programs)
(1) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment revokes the designation of an excellent environmental education program under Article 22(1) of the Act, the Minister shall notify the person developing and operating that environmental education program in writing, specifying the reasons. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment revokes the designation of an excellent environmental education program under paragraph (1), the Minister shall publicly announce that fact on the website of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment without delay. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 11 (Designation of the National Environmental Education Center)
(1) "Projects prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment" in Article 24(1)6 of the Act means the following projects: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Provision of training opportunities and support for research activities for teachers, etc. under Article 12 of the Act;
2. Support for continuing training for environmental educators under Article 18 of the Act;
3. Informatization of environmental education.
(2) A person intending to obtain designation as the National Environmental Education Center under Article 24(1) of the Act and Article 18(2) of the Decree shall submit an application for designation in attached Form 12, accompanied by the following documents, to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Documents proving compliance with the requirements in Appendix 2 of the Decree;
2. An operating plan for the National Environmental Education Center.
(3) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries designates the National Environmental Education Center under Article 24(1) of the Act, the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation in attached Form 13 and publicly announce the designation on the website of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) Except as provided in paragraphs (2) and (3), matters necessary for designation of the National Environmental Education Center shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment in consultation with the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 12 (Revocation of designation of the National Environmental Education Center and regional environmental education centers)
(1) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment revokes the designation of the National Environmental Education Center under Article 26(1) of the Act, the Minister shall notify the institution in writing, specifying the reasons. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Where a Mayor/Do Governor revokes the designation of a metropolitan environmental education center under Article 26(1) of the Act, the Mayor/Do Governor shall hear the opinion of the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment in advance and notify the institution in writing, specifying the reasons. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(3) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or a Mayor/Do Governor revokes the designation of the National Environmental Education Center or a metropolitan environmental education center under paragraph (1) or (2), the Minister or Mayor/Do Governor shall publicly announce that fact on the website of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment or the relevant City/Do without delay. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 13 (Environmental education cities)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment may designate a City/Do or Si/Gun/Gu (a Gu means an autonomous Gu; hereinafter the same shall apply) that meets the following criteria as an environmental education city under Article 27(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "environmental education city"): <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Its plans or implementation results for promoting environmental education shall be excellent;
2. Its foundation for promoting environmental education shall be excellent.
(2) A Mayor/Do Governor or the head of a Si/Gun/Gu intending to apply for designation of an environmental education city under paragraph (1) shall submit an application in attached Form 14 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, accompanied by documents including the following matters: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Plans or implementation results for promoting environmental education;
2. Matters concerning the foundation for promoting environmental education.
(3) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment receiving an application under paragraph (2) designates the relevant City/Do or Si/Gun/Gu as an environmental education city, the Minister shall issue a certificate of designation in attached Form 15. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(4) The period of validity of designation of an environmental education city under Article 27(4) of the Act shall be three years.
(5) Except as provided in paragraphs (1) through (4), matters necessary for designation of environmental education cities shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 14 (Review of regulations) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review the appropriateness of the criteria for revocation and suspension of environmental educator qualifications under Article 5 and Appendix 1, using January 6, 2022 as the reference date (meaning by the day preceding the date corresponding to that reference date in every third year), and take measures such as improvements. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

ADDENDA <Ministerial Decree No. 527, January 6, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Rule shall enter into force on January 6, 2022.

Article 2 (Relationship to other statutes and regulations) Where other statutes or regulations cite the previous Enforcement Rule of the Environmental Education Promotion Act or any provision thereof as at the time this Rule enters into force, and this Rule contains a corresponding provision, they shall be deemed to cite this Rule or the corresponding provision of this Rule in place of the previous Enforcement Rule of the Environmental Education Promotion Act or its provision.

ADDENDUM <Ministerial Decree No. 590, February 28, 2023>

This Rule shall enter into force on March 1, 2023.

ADDENDUM <Ministerial Decree No. 704, November 13, 2024>

This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Decree of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Partially Amending Five Statutes and Regulations to Improve Regulations on Economic Activities) <Ministerial Decree No. 726, March 11, 2025>

This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Decree of the Ministry of Environment Partially Amending Two Statutes and Regulations to Improve Regulations on Economic Activities) <Ministerial Decree No. 1163, March 11, 2025>

This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM <Ministerial Decree No. 1190, September 30, 2025>

This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Ministerial Decree No. 1, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, with respect to Ministerial Decrees amended under Article 6 of the Addenda that have been promulgated before this Rule enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived, the provisions amending such Ministerial Decrees shall enter into force on the enforcement dates of the respective Ministerial Decrees.

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to other statutes and regulations) Paragraphs (1) through (86) Omitted.
(87) The Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education is partially amended as follows:
In the introductory part of Article 2(2), Article 2(3) and (4), Article 7(1), Article 8, the first and second sentences of Article 9(2), Article 9(3) and (5), Article 10(1) and (2), the introductory part of Article 11(2), Article 11(3) and (4), Article 12(1) through (3), the introductory part of Article 13(1), the introductory part of Article 13(2), Article 13(3) and (5), and Article 14, "Minister of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Articles 2(4), 8, 9(3), and 10(2), "of the Ministry of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In the introductory parts of Articles 6(1) and 11(1), "Decree of the Ministry of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Decree of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Articles 11(3) and 12(3), "Ministry of Environment or" is replaced in each instance with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment or".

In subparagraph 1 of Appendix 3 and in subparagraph 2(a) and (b) of that Appendix, "Ministry of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In attached Forms 1 and 2, the processing-procedure section of attached Form 5, attached Form 6, and attached Forms 8 through 15, "Minister of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In the processing-procedure sections of attached Forms 1, 8, 10, 12, and 14, "Ministry of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

Paragraphs (88) through (98) Omitted.
